config.label: Polar OAuth client ID
config.description: Polar OAuth client ID. Optional when configured with polar-mcp-server setup.

config.label: Polar OAuth client secret
config.description: Polar OAuth client secret. Prefer polar-mcp-server setup so this secret is stored in ~/.polar-mcp/config.json instead of MCP client config.

config.label: Redirect URI configured in the Polar AccessLink admin
config.description: Redirect URI configured in the Polar AccessLink admin. Optional when configured with polar-mcp-server setup.

config.label: Optional local path for OAuth tokens
config.description: Optional local path for OAuth tokens. Defaults to ~/.polar-mcp/tokens.json.

config.label: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw
config.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured. raw means full Polar AccessLink payloads for supported endpoints.

config.label: Optional SQLite cache toggle
config.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

config.label: Optional local SQLite cache path
config.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.polar-mcp/cache.sqlite.

config.label: Set to true to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache (60s TTL for GET only)
config.description: Set to true to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache (60s TTL for GET only). POST/PUT/DELETE and 4xx/5xx responses are never cached regardless.
